---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    player = str_c(first(nameFirst), first(nameLast), sep = " "),
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(
    steroid_era_active = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Yes",
      "No"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era_active
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Active during steroid era?",
    values = c("No" = "grey50", "Yes" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career home runs of the top 15 MLB sluggers",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Steroid-era overlap: career spans 1994-2009. Source: Lahman database."
  )
```

## Barry Bonds by season

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(yearID), y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#D55E00") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' home runs by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
